descriptionMarkdown: Very simple and easy to use, instructions included. Due to how efficient nuclear power is, you don't actually have to set up kovarex enrichment to fuel it. Enough power to carry you until the end of the game if you don't spam too many beacons. Combined with efficiency modules and going green early, you can reduce pollution by up to 80%, plus you don't have to worry about power consumption.
